orgs.name: Wake County Continuum of Care (NC-507) — Coordinated Entry
services: FRONT DOOR: the Wake County Continuum of Care (NC-507, Raleigh/Wake County) runs Coordinated Entry — the single assessment and referral system for homeless services in Wake County; it routes people to shelter, outreach, diversion, rapid rehousing and permanent supportive housing rather than paying assistance itself

Coordinated Entry access sites include Oak City Cares (walk-in, downtown Raleigh), Haven House (youth and young adults 18-24), The Women's Center (single women), St John's MCC (4 N Blount St, Raleigh 27601) and The Salvation Army (families)

The CoC body is the HUD-recognized collaborative structure for Wake County: Haven House Inc was the FY2024 collaborative applicant and Urban Ministries of Wake County the FY2024 HMIS Lead; in the FY2026 competition, Wake County Government is the applicant for HMIS, SSO-Coordinated Entry and CoC Planning projects (see fiscal/wake.md)
orgs.serves: Anyone experiencing or at risk of homelessness in Wake County — CoC office at 112 Cox Ave, Raleigh 27605
